translations.answer: The original post only proposes candidate diagnostic directions: verifying the size of action chunks and timestamps of each sample, confirming whether the 100 Hz cycle is interrupted or repeated, and measuring round-trip cloud-to-ground delay and jitter. Whether interpolation or buffer schemes are sufficient remains undetermined; the integration of these schemes with the MPC horizon needs experimental validation.
translations.applicability: Applicable to low-frequency remote strategies and high-frequency local MPC/WBC in a multi-rate system; does not represent the official Pi0.5 architecture.
translations.credibility.rationale: Engineering records exist for the environment, processing steps, and results, but formal cross-validation or independent replication is lacking.
translations.details.attempts.0: The original post only proposes candidate causes and discusses issues, without reporting implemented interpolation, buffer, or timestamp alignment schemes.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Verify strategy/control frequency ratio, action chunk size, old target reuse method, end-to-end delay, and delay jitter.
translations.details.environments.0: Cloud RTX 4090 running Pi0.5; 1 Hz strategy output; local 100 Hz MPC; round-trip link latency.
translations.details.limits.0: Missing action chunk, delay distribution, target interpolation, MPC horizon/cost and delay spectrum data.
translations.details.outcomes.0: No fixed answer or validation result is available for the visible content.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: The 1 Hz cloud strategy drives the 100 Hz local MPC, causing the arm to continuously vibrate and trajectory to be uneven.
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Limit speed, acceleration, and torque until the root cause of the vibration is confirmed; first validate multi-rate bridge in simulation or low-power mode.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: Low-frequency strategy commands are interrupted or stopped between 100 Hz control cycles.
translations.details.suspected_causes.1: MPC repeatedly tracks old targets, combined with network delay fluctuations, causing discontinuous correction.
translations.details.symptoms.0: The arm continues to vibrate and the trajectory is uneven.
translations.media_summaries.0: Visible images show the post title and parameter summary card, displaying 1 Hz cloud inference, 100 Hz local MPC, and the vibration issue; does not include control curve, end-to-end delay histogram, or log, and cannot determine the vibration frequency or root cause from the image.
